findings_summary.title: Defense boundary mapped: client v2.28.0 spendControls already reject asset/network swaps pre-signer; unguarded surface = amount within cap (both directions), payTo substitution, resource/method binding

notes: Closes the #3866 reviewer round-2 asks (NSPG13 2026-10-22; TKCollective 2026-10-24): (1) unchanged-quote positive case WITH control mode enabled — signs x2, zero rejections, gate does not break the honest case; (2) per-field change battery — payTo rejected by control before signer, asset/network rejected by the client's own spendControls (observe-mode mirrors prove the built-in guard), resource/method change = new binding with caller-expectation coverage; (3) mid-session price DROP (bait-down) rejected before signer; (4) anchor integrity — a rejected quote never becomes the accepted anchor (signer x0, rejected x2); (5) case semantics renamed: quote-change sessions are two completed mocked cycles, not a lost-response retry. Context: independent corroboration of #3866 by three third-party implementations (Boundra replay 6/6 cross-checks; TKCollective Tanilo hook tests; 402Shield doc-only mapping), zero maintainer engagement on the thread as of 2026-10-24.
